symptom: Switching between Storyboard, Canvas, and List exposed capability and layout drift: List Detail rendered read-only 4-line truncated text and 48 fake static audio bars without inline toolbars, recoverable dual actions, or version dimension backfill; clicking pick-on-canvas from List immediately cancelled on unmount and failed to return; switching modes in Storyboard wiped compatible parameters.
direct_cause: GenerationListParts and GenerationListDetail maintained handwritten read-only preview subsets and bare setNodeMainResult calls because Canvas node toolbars/controls called @xyflow/react useViewport() unconditionally, canvasPickMode lacked list round-trip state, and ShotComposerBar passed params: undefined on mode changes.
class_root: Node stage capabilities, main-version switching side effects, cross-view canvas picking, and mode-switch parameter reconciliation lacked coordinate-free shared boundaries and a compile-time exhaustive GenerationNodeKind surface contract.
affected_population: Creators switching between Storyboard, Generation Canvas, and Generation List (including List Detail) across macOS/Windows in zh-CN and en
entry_points: Generation Canvas node rendering and version switching (BaseGenerationNode, NodeVersionCardsHost)
Generation List grid creation/import and List Detail coaxial stage (GenerationListView, GenerationListDetail, GenerationListParts)
Cross-view reference picking from List composer to Canvas (canvasPickMode)
Creation Storyboard shot and anchor mode switching (ShotComposerBar, StoryboardShotRow, StoryboardAnchorRow)

external_sources.purpose: Confirm useViewport requires ReactFlowProvider context, motivating host-separated toolbar/control wrappers via NodeStageHostContext.

invariants: Every GenerationNodeKind must satisfy Record<GenerationNodeKind, NodeSurfaceContract> so no view maintains unguarded kind subsets.
Both BaseGenerationNode and GenerationListDetail render node content, error/recoverable cards, inline/floating toolbars, and sample rows through coordinate-free NodeStageSurface.
Switching a node's primary version always executes through switchNodeMainVersion (single production write door to setNodeMainResult).
Entering canvas pick mode from List preserves active pick across list unmount and restores list + inspectorKey upon pick or cancel.
Storyboard mode switches reconcile parameters via resolveModelParams rather than wiping params to undefined.
generality_proof: Extracting coordinate-free NodeStageSurface with NodeStageHostContext, consolidating switchNodeMainVersion (setNodeMainResult write doors 2 -> 1) and canvasPickMode list round-trip, routing Storyboard mode switches through resolveModelParams, and locking all 17 GenerationNodeKind entries with satisfies Record<GenerationNodeKind, NodeSurfaceContract> eliminates view-local subsets structurally.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Compile-time exhaustive capability and stage-mode contract for every GenerationNodeKind across Canvas and List.
Single coordinate-free host for node body, editable rich text, audio/transcript SRT, failure/recoverable recovery, media toolbars, and sample row across canvas and list-detail.
Single domain command committing active whiteboard state and backfilling media dimensions before calling setNodeMainResult.
Cross-view reference pick state machine preserving active pick across list-to-canvas unmount and restoring list inspector state on pick or cancel.
Shared Storyboard mode-switch parameter adapter backed by resolveModelParams so compatible parameters survive mode changes.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Canvas node shell delegates node body, error/recoverable cards, media toolbars, and sample row to NodeStageSurface(host="canvas").
List inspector mounts NodeStageSurface(host="list-detail") on a coaxial 600px stage and delegates version switching to switchNodeMainVersion.
Canvas version grid delegates primary version switching to switchNodeMainVersion instead of duplicating dimension backfill and setNodeMainResult.
Storyboard shot bar delegates mode switching to buildStoryboardModeChangeParams backed by resolveModelParams.
Storyboard visual anchor bar and reference strip delegate mode switching to buildStoryboardModeChangeParams.

recurrence.reason: Every node capability added on Canvas (rich-text selection rewrite, real audio/transcript SRT, recoverable retrieval vs resend, post-processing toolbars, version dimension backfill, parameter retention) drifted in List and Storyboard because parallel view-local subsets existed.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs setNodeMainResult -> reduced from 2 write doors (GenerationListDetail, NodeVersionCardsHost) to 1 (switchNodeMainVersion)
node scripts/door-map.mjs enterCanvasPickMode -> checked all 3 callers (ProjectAgentResidentShell, nodeSlotReferencePick, nodeInputActions) for list-to-canvas unmount survival and round-trip
git grep onModeChange / onSwitchMode across src/workbench/creation/storyboard/ -> routed ShotComposerBar, StoryboardShotRow, and StoryboardAnchorRow through buildStoryboardModeChangeParams
git grep useViewport across src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/ -> wrapped NodeFloatingToolbar, NodeVideoClipPanel, and NodeVideoControls via NodeStageHostContext

prevention.invariant: Every GenerationNodeKind must satisfy Record<GenerationNodeKind, NodeSurfaceContract>, both Canvas and List Detail render node stages through NodeStageSurface, and setNodeMainResult is written only through switchNodeMainVersion.
prevention.failure_mode: Adding an unregistered GenerationNodeKind fails TypeScript compilation; reintroducing fake list previews, bare setNodeMainResult calls, or mode-switch parameter wipes fails threeSurfacesParity.goal.test.tsx.
prevention.strategy: Combine satisfies Record<GenerationNodeKind, NodeSurfaceContract> compile-time exhaustiveness with coordinate-free NodeStageSurface, single-door switchNodeMainVersion, list-aware canvasPickMode round-trip, and resolveModelParams mode reconciliation.

legacy_paths.rationale: Deleted handwritten read-only TextPreview and 48-bar fake AudioStrip from GenerationListParts.tsx, deleted DetailPreview and bare setNodeMainResult from GenerationListDetail.tsx, and deleted params: undefined mode-switch wipe from ShotComposerBar.tsx.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: All defects originated in internal view/command boundaries; zero external npm packages were added or modified.

migration: No persistent project schema changed; existing text, audio/transcript, image/video, multi-version history, and storyboard PlanShot records render directly through the shared stage and parameter resolver.
residual_risks: Spatial canvas-only tools (director 3D stage, clip timeline node, shot_table) intentionally display an explicit Open-in-Canvas pointer in List Detail rather than embedding multi-node spatial canvases inside a 600px column.
Windows native rendering was not verified on this macOS host and relies on CI cross-platform checks.
